caption: The video captures a tight, eye-level close-up of a painted metal railing above a pale ledge, with a small translucent dome-shaped droplet resting at the center in front of the bars. A vertical bar crosses the upper middle and a thicker flared post stands to the right of the droplet, both appearing steady relative to the image edges. The droplet retains a similar rounded size and shape throughout, its thin glossy film spreading at the base without visibly sliding or vanishing. The heavily out-of-focus background shows dark green foliage with bright circular bokeh on the left and a soft pale wall on the right. Blurred highlights flicker and shift in shape and brightness, and the indistinct foliage behind the railing changes slightly. The horizontal bar, vertical bar, right post, and ledge remain largely fixed, so the foreground stays steady while the soft background shimmer continues. No dripping or movement of the railing or droplet appears, and the flare at the post's base remains unchanged.
